title: Equality of the legacy and upstream exterior presheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a sheaf of modules, and n a natural number. The presheaf exteriorSheafPresheaf M n of [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] equals the upstream PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower M.val n: both have sections the nth exterior power over O_X(U), and their semilinear restrictions agree. This holds without freeness assumptions, including n=0 and zero section rings.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph, lines 140-147; equality of the two implementations of its sectionwise exterior powers. Implementations read in lean/Sheaf/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/ExteriorSheaf.lean and lean/WeilConjectures/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/ExteriorPower.lean.

proof.text: The object families agree definitionally. For any restriction f, the upstream exteriorPower_map_ιMulti sends a pure wedge to the wedge of the restrictions. It therefore satisfies the property in exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique. Its uniqueness identifies the maps; function extensionality and proof irrelevance identify the presheaf structures.
